machine.disclaimer:

machine.description: Dual-spindle 300mm wafer dicing system utilizing high-speed diamond blades (up to 60,000 RPM) with DI water cooling jets to singulate silicon, GaN, and GaAs wafers into discrete micro-dies.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Wafers mounted on UV dicing tape are placed on a porous ceramic vacuum chuck table. High-pressure DI water jets cool the blade kerf and flush silicon swarf while dual microscope cameras align scribe lanes with sub-micron precision.
subsystems: Porous Ceramic Vacuum Chuck & Work Stage
DI Water Coolant Delivery & Jet Nozzle System
High-Resolution Vision Alignment & Kerf Inspection Optical System
Diamond Blade Flange & Auto-Contact Touch Sensor
Dressing Board Mechanism for Blade Sharpening

components.name: Air-Bearing Spindle Assembly
components.function: Drives diamond blade at 30,000 to 60,000 RPM with sub-micron radial runout.
components.importantParameters: Spindle speed (RPM), radial vibration (mm/s), motor load (%).
components.degradationIndicators: High-frequency harmonic vibration (>1.2 mm/s), bearing temperature rise.

components.name: Resinoid Diamond Blade
components.function: Precision mechanical shearing along wafer scribe lines.
components.importantParameters: Blade outer diameter, kerf width (µm), blade wear index (µm).
components.degradationIndicators: Wafer backside chipping (>25µm), kerf widening, blade edge loading.

components.name: DI Water Coolant Delivery
components.function: Cools cutting interface and evacuates silicon particulate swarf.
components.degradationIndicators: Nozzle pressure drop (<1.5 bar), coolant temperature drift (>28°C).

components.name: Porous Ceramic Vacuum Chuck
components.function: Immobilizes wafer dicing tape carrier during high-velocity cutting.
components.degradationIndicators: Vacuum leakage (>-60 kPa), particulate clogging in ceramic pores.

sensors.name: Spindle Radial Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors air-bearing dynamic stability and blade balance.

sensors.name: DI Water Coolant Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures coolant temperature delivered to cutting kerf.

sensors.name: Spindle Motor Load
sensors.purpose: Monitors electrical motor load percentage during cutting.

sensors.name: Coolant Jet Pressure
sensors.purpose: Monitors fluid pressure delivered to dual cutting nozzles.

warning.description: Bearing raceway harmonic wear or blade unbalance

critical.description: Overheating kerf causing wafer thermal cracking

warning.description: Blade loading or feed rate mismatch

critical.description: Blade micro-binding and motor stall risk

normal.description: Monitors fluid pressure delivered to dual cutting nozzles.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Laminar DI water flow > 2.8 L/min, vacuum chuck > -85 kPa
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 120 continuous operating hours before blade touch-off calibration

maintenance.procedureSummary: Unclamp blade flange, install calibrated 0.025mm blade, execute auto-contact touch-off sequence.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Dynamic spindle re-balancing & air filter replacement
maintenance.procedureSummary: Verify CDA dewpoint < -40°C, inspect labyrinth seal purge ring, run accelerometer FFT spectral check.

degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes wafer backside chipping along scribe line
Thermal expansion causes blade kerf drift

rulModel.modelName: Wafer Saw Linear Weighted Degradation Model

symptoms.recommendedAction: Dress blade with silicon carbide dressing stick and verify spindle vibration < 0.5 mm/s.
Re-align coolant spray nozzle directly on blade tangent and purge vacuum line filter.

possibleCauses: Silicon slurry ingress past labyrinth seal
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace diamond blade, flush DI coolant circuit, and dynamic-balance spindle rotor.
verificationSteps: Inspect spindle runout with dial gauge (< 0.5µm)
Perform 5-wafer test cut and inspect kerf under microscope
